title: Staff Security Governance Engineer, Policies & Standards
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h4><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h4> <p>As a Staff Security Governance Engineer, you will be the individual contributor who owns how GitLab writes, maintains, communicates, and measures its security policies and standards. You will turn emerging regulations, including AI regulation, into clear requirements that engineering, product, and legal teams can act on, and you will use automation to keep governance lightweight and continuous rather than a point-in-time exercise. You will sit on the Security Governance team within Security Assurance and work closely with Security Compliance, Security Risk, and GRC Engineering. You will report to the Director, Customer Trust & Security Governance.</p> <h4><strong>What you'll do</strong></h4> <ul> <li><em>Policies and standards</em></li> <ul> <li>Own the end-to-end lifecycle of GitLab's security policies, standards, procedures, and guidelines: drafting, stakeholder review, approval, publication, annual review, and retirement.</li> <li>Define and run the exception management process, including risk-based approvals, expiry tracking, and trend reporting that shows where policies need to change.</li> <li>Run policy attestation and investigate non-adherence.</li> <li>Keep policies clear, practical, and aligned with how GitLab's engineering teams work in a DevSecOps environment.</li> </ul> <li><em>Regulatory and framework alignment</em></li> <ul> <li>Monitor emerging regulations and standards (e.g., EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, sector or regional requirements) and partner with Legal well ahead of compliance deadlines to assess impact and update policy.</li> <li>Maintain mappings between our policies and frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 42001, FedRAMP, and NIST CSF, so requirements are written once and reused.</li> </ul> <li><em>Measurement and assurance</em></li> <ul> <li>Define KPIs for policy adherence and report trends to Security leadership.</li> <li>Run targeted internal assessments of adherence and drive remediation to closure.</li> <li>Support audit activities by coordinating evidence, testing, and remediation management.</li> </ul> <li><em>Customer trust</em></li> <ul> <li>Support customer questionnaires and customer meetings, and help turn recurring customer requests into better policies and self-service content.</li> </ul> <li><em>Automation and AI</em></li> <ul> <li>Identify and implement automation and AI-assisted workflows for policy management, evidence collection, control monitoring, and assessment work, in partnership with GRC Engineering.</li> </ul> <li><em>Technical leadership</em></li> <ul> <li>Act as a technical and program leader across Security, Product, Legal, and Engineering, influencing without direct authority.</li> <li>Mentor other team members and help set the direction of the Security Governance roadmap.</li> </ul> </ul> <h4><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h4> <ul> <li>10+ years in security governance, GRC, or IT risk, with hands-on ownership of a policy and standards lifecycle and measurable outcomes, ideally at a global technology company.</li> <li>Working knowledge of SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 42001, FedRAMP, and NIST CSF, including how to put them into practice, not only how to read them.</li> <li>Understanding of cloud, SaaS, and DevSecOps practices, and the ability to write policy that engineers will follow.</li> <li>A risk-based mindset that balances compliance with real security risk.</li> <li>Demonstrated use of automation or AI to reduce manual GRC work.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication, including translating technical concepts for engineers, executives, auditors, and customers.</li> <li>Experience collaborating with Security, Product, Legal, and Engineering.</li> <li>Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, or similar are highly desirable.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>What success looks like</strong></h4> <ul> <li>First 30 days: Assessed the current policy library and exception process, built relationships with key stakeholders, and proposed a prioritized roadmap.</li> <li>First 90 days: Uplift the existing security policy library to align with NIST CSF, ISO 27001/27017/27018/42001, and PCI-DSS.</li> <li>First 120 days: A refreshed review cadence is in place, exception reporting is running, and can demonstrate a measurable improvement in policy adherence.</li> <li>First six months: Develop Policy as Code and collaborate with Security, Product, Legal, and Engineering for implementation into existing workflows.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>About the team</strong></h4> <p>The Security Assurance organization helps GitLab build and maintain trust by strengthening how we approach security, compliance, and risk. Security Governance sits within it and owns customer trust, security awareness, policies and standards, and other governance functions. Our counterparts are Security Compliance, Security Risk, and GRC Engineering. <br><br>You will join a small team of four direct reports under the Director, where each person has broad scope and visible impact. title: Senior Account Executive (Europe, 100% remote)
description: Join our fully remote, mission-driven team dedicated to pioneering sustainable inflight service management . Work on innovative technology solutions with global impact, collaborate within a diverse, international environment, and continuously enhance your skills through ongoing learning opportunities. Headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland with team members across 11 countries, we offer a dynamic and engaging company culture that celebrates creativity, collaboration, and inclusion. About the role We are on a mission to contribute to a zero-waste future by drastically reducing food waste, fuel consumption, costs, and most importantly, CO₂ emissions in the airline industry. Every role in our company is a direct contributor to this vision and as a Senior Account Executive, you will be at the heart of the team that makes it possible. You will report directly to one of the founders and work closely with Account Executives, Marketing, Product Management, Customer Success, and the broader founding team. This is not a traditional SaaS sales role focused on high-volume transactions. Our customers are airlines, our sales cycles are complex, and our relationships often span many years. You will be responsible for building and executing strategic sales plans, identifying and developing new opportunities, and managing enterprise sales cycles from initial engagement through to contract signature. Rather than relying solely on inbound demand, you will proactively identify target airlines, build stakeholder relationships, and develop opportunities through a structured account-based sales approach. We are looking for someone who has already built pipeline, navigated complex airline buying processes, and personally closed significant enterprise business. You will bring both the experience and confidence to independently lead opportunities while collaborating effectively with founders and subject matter experts throughout the sales process. This is a hands-on individual contributor role. While you will mentor and coach junior sales colleagues, your primary responsibility is generating pipeline, advancing opportunities, and winning new business. If your primary motivation is managing teams rather than selling, this role is not going to be a good fit. Key responsibilities Strategic Enterprise Sales Own the full sales cycle from prospecting to contract signature Develop and execute account-based sales strategies for airline customers Build relationships with executive and senior stakeholders Lead commercial negotiations and enterprise procurement processes Create and maintain strategic account plans Pipeline Generation & Market Development Identify and pursue new growth opportunities with airlines globally Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of qualified opportunities Develop stakeholder maps and engagement strategies Generate opportunities through industry networking, referrals, partnerships, and events Continuously expand LimeFlight's presence within the airline industry Commercial Leadership Lead by example through active pipeline creation, opportunity management, and enterprise sales execution Mentor and coach junior sales team members Support deal reviews, account planning, and opportunity strategy Share best practices for enterprise sales execution and stakeholder management Contribute to the continuous improvement of sales methodologies and commercial processes Cross-functional Collaboration Work closely with Marketing, Customer Success, Product, Implementation, and Founder teams Coordinate internal resources throughout the sales cycle Ensure customer requirements are clearly understood and communicated internally Support smooth transitions from sales into implementation and customer success Act as the voice of the market and customer within LimeFlight Key competencies 10+ years of enterprise B2B sales experience, including significant experience selling to airlines Proven track record of generating pipeline through strategic account-based selling Demonstrated success selling enterprise software, SaaS, or technology solutions to large airline organizations Track record of personally leading and closing enterprise opportunities with a combined contract value exceeding CHF 3 million Experience managing six- and seven-figure enterprise sales opportunities Strong understanding of airline buying processes, stakeholder management, and enterprise procurement Ability to independently drive opportunities forward within complex stakeholder environments Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills Strong commercial and business acumen Collaborative mindset with a team-first attitude Passion for mentoring and developing others High degree of ownership, accountability, and resilience Strongly Preferred Direct experience selling SaaS or enterprise software solutions to airlines. Existing network within the airline industry Deep understanding of airline operations and organizational structures Experience selling across different global markets, with the ability to adapt sales strategies and stakeholder engagement approaches to regional business cultures and buying processes. Experience coaching or mentoring junior commercial team members Language Fluent English required Additional languages are a plus Expected travel needs You should be willing to travel up to 30% of the year for customer meetings, industry conferences, trade shows, and relationship-building activities. Given the relationship-driven nature of the airline industry, regular face-to-face interactions are an important part of the role. Hiring Process Recruiter Screen (45 mins) Interview with Hiring Manager (1 hour) Technical Interview (1 hour) Discussion with founder(s) and peer(s) LimeFlight is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or background can thrive and do their best work. Join us and be part of a team committed to shaping a zero-waste future for aviation, where your ideas and passion truly matter. Let’s talk! Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Solutions Architect
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As a Senior Solutions Architect you'll be a trusted advisor to GitLab prospects and customers, helping them understand how GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform addresses both technical requirements and business objectives across the entire software development lifecycle. You'll guide organizations through their digital transformation journeys, from planning through monitoring, using your technical expertise, understanding of cloud and modern software development practices, and strong customer empathy.</p> <p>Reporting to a regional Solutions Architect Manager and partnering closely with Account Executives and cross-functional teams, you'll own technical evaluations, including proofs of value and workshops, shape solution architectures, and serve as the voice of the customer back to Product Management. You'll focus on driving successful platform adoption, influencing revenue growth through solution selling, and building long-term, trust-based relationships that showcase GitLab's differentiated position in an AI-driven DevSecOps landscape.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Lead technical discovery, demos, and validation to show how GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform meets customers' technical and business needs across the full lifecycle.</li> <li>Drive the technical evaluation process as the directly responsible individual, including solution design, proof of concept or proof of value ownership, workshop design, and the technical components of tenders, audits, and value stream assessments.</li> <li>Collaborate with Account Executives and regional sales teams across Italy to shape and execute account strategies that support new customer acquisition and expansion.</li> <li>Build and deepen relationships with technical practitioners and business leaders, guiding them through GitLab-driven transformation and enabling them to become GitLab advocates.</li> <li>Advise customers on modern software development, continuous integration, continuous deployment, security, and cloud practices, challenging existing approaches to improve return on investment.</li> <li>Serve as the voice of the customer with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing by sharing feedback, use cases, and competitive insights that inform roadmap and positioning.</li> <li>Maintain and extend your technical expertise in GitLab, DevSecOps, AI, and related cloud technologies, creating reusable examples, best practice guidance, and technical collateral for customers and partners.</li> <li>Invest in your own growth and development through ongoing learning, mentorship, and knowledge sharing to continuously improve the impact of the Solutions Architect team.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience engaging with customers in technical pre-sales, consulting, or similar roles, guiding them through solution design and evaluation.</li> <li>Proficiency with the end-to-end software development lifecycle, including modern DevSecOps practices and continuous integration and continuous deployment workflows.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with GitLab or comparable source control, continuous integration and continuous deployment, and collaboration platforms, and the ability to map platform capabilities to customer use cases.</li> <li>Practical knowledge of cloud computing concepts and related technologies, with the ability to discuss deployment, security, and operations options with technical teams.</li> <li>Ability to lead technical evaluations such as proofs of concept or proofs of value, contribute to tenders or audits, and design and run workshops or value stream assessments.</li> <li>Clear technical communication and presentation skills, with the ability to adapt messages for practitioners through to senior business and technical decision makers.</li> <li>Skill in building trusted relationships, listening with empathy, and acting as a customer advocate to internal teams such as Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing.</li> <li>Motivation to continuously develop professionally, including learning new technologies, deepening GitLab platform expertise, and applying transferable experience from related fields.</li> <li>Fluency in Arabic.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The Solutions Architect team is part of GitLab's Sales organization and serves as the technical counterpart to Account Executives. The team helps customers realize the full value of GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform by advising on architecture, running technical evaluations such as proofs of value, and guiding customers through digital transformation. We work closely with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing, collaborating asynchronously across regions to share best practices, create reusable technical collateral, and act as the voice of the customer. The team is focused on helping customers modernize end-to-end software delivery, adopt GitLab at scale, and navigate a rapidly evolving AI and DevSecOps landscape.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. title: Professional Services Engineer - West
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>Intermediate Professional Services, Technical Architect </strong></h2> <h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As a Professional Services Technical Architect at GitLab, you'll lead the technical direction of customer engagements from early scoping and discovery through delivery. You'll design high-level architectures and implementation plans for GitLab infrastructure and functionality, and you'll make sure deliverables align with customer requirements and the Statement of Work (SOW). You'll coordinate and guide implementation work across GitLab Professional Services and partner consultants, support customers deploying GitLab in cloud and on-premises environments using tools like Terraform, Ansible, and the GitLab Environment Toolkit, and perform migrations to GitLab using Congregate. You'll provide DevOps and DevSecOps consulting and best practices, contribute reusable collateral such as documentation, delivery kits, and training materials, and share product release updates to help the team deliver consistent outcomes. This role combines deep technical expertise with customer-facing leadership in GitLab's remote, asynchronous, and values-driven environment.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Designing and delivering GitLab reference architecture implementations for both self-managed and cloud environments, using infrastructure as code practices</li> <li>Leading source code management and CI/CD migrations to GitLab, including large-scale enterprise moves using Congregate</li> <li>Building repeatable delivery kits, documentation, and enablement materials that help Professional Services and partners deploy and adopt GitLab best practices</li> <li>Lead the full technical delivery lifecycle for GitLab Professional Services engagements, from early scoping and technical discovery through implementation and handoff.</li> <li>Produce high-level and detailed technical designs for GitLab infrastructure and functionality, ensuring deliverables align with customer requirements and expectations.</li> <li>Evaluate and communicate scalability and security considerations (including compliance constraints) in proposed GitLab reference architectures and implementation plans.</li> <li>Deploy and configure GitLab in customer environments, including on-premises and major cloud providers, using Terraform, Ansible, and the GitLab Environment Toolkit (GET) aligned to reference architectures.</li> <li>Plan and execute source system migrations to GitLab using Congregate, partnering closely with customer stakeholders to reduce risk, protect data integrity, and minimize downtime.</li> <li>Provide DevOps and DevSecOps consulting and best-practice guidance, including advising on internal frameworks such as the Delivery Governance Framework (DGF) and GitLab Flow.</li> <li>Coordinate and oversee implementation work across GitLab team members, partners, and customer points of contact (POCs), ensuring clear asynchronous communication and decision capture, effective execution, and high-quality outcomes.</li> <li>Mentor Professional Services and partner consultants by contributing documentation, delivery kits, and training materials, and by leading enablement sessions on how to deliver and position service offerings.</li> <li>Maintain and improve delivery automation assets with an emphasis on code cleanliness, maintainability, and appropriate unit/integration testing.</li> <li>Support scoping and Statement of Work (SOW) creation with Professional Services Engagement Managers, stay current on monthly GitLab releases, and help Regional Delivery Managers with technical vetting and staffing assessments while maintaining a 55% billable utilization.</li> <li>Review and provide input to Professional Services training materials and presentations</li> <li>Develop case studies, presentations, design documentation, and best-practice methodologies</li> <li>Work closely with customer project teams to ensure accurate task-level articulation of work required</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to lead technical discussions with customers and partners and communicate risks/trade-offs clearly in an asynchronous environment.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Prefer location in PST, MST or CST timezone alignment. </strong><strong>Comfortable with up to 30% travel at times.</strong><strong>Demonstrated experience delivering two or more of the following consulting services: source code management migration, cloud architecture, DevOps engineering, or continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) consulting services.</strong><strong>Enterprise software development experience, with the ability to translate requirements into clear technical designs and implementation plans.</strong><strong>Progressive DevOps platform experience, including designing and implementing reliable, scalable systems with clear performance and security trade-offs.</strong><strong>Hands-on experience deploying and managing infrastructure in cloud providers and on-premises environments, including using tools such as Terraform and Ansible.</strong><strong>Ability to write clean, maintainable automation/integration code (e.g., Terraform modules, Ansible roles, scripts) and validate changes with appropriate testing and code review.</strong><strong>Experience performing migrations to GitLab, including using Congregate or similar migration tooling.</strong><strong>Working knowledge of data consistency and integrity concepts (e.g., ACID properties) and how they impact migration design and performance trade-offs.</strong><strong>Strong problem-solving, decision-making, organizational, and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities with minimal supervision.</strong><strong>Comfort working in a remote, asynchronous environment, using documented decisions (e.g., issues, proposals, and runbooks) to keep work unblocked across time zones while collaborating effectively across GitLab team members, partners, and customer stakeholders.</strong><strong>Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or other advanced technical degree, or equivalent experience</strong></h4> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The Professional Services Technical Architect is part of GitLab's Professional Services organization. We partner with customers who are transitioning to GitLab, expanding how they use an existing GitLab installation, or planning complex upgrades to their infrastructure and processes. Our team brings a diverse set of skills across GitLab deployment, maintenance, and day-to-day usage, along with deep technical knowledge of adjacent tools and platforms. Working closely with Engagement Managers, partner consultants, and customer stakeholders, we focus on delivering high-quality outcomes, sharing best practices, and helping customers realize faster time to value from their GitLab investment. We operate in GitLab's remote, asynchronous environment and rely on clear documentation and transparent communication to collaborate effectively.</p> <p>This role models skills and behavior aligned with GitLab Values and typically reports to the Regional Delivery Manager. As a Professional Services Technical Architect, you will work more independently than an associate consultant, leveraging deep technical expertise to drive customer outcomes.</p> <h4><br><br><br><br><br></h4><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. title: Senior Product Manager, Billing Engine & Platforms Monetization
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>Credit-based and consumption-based offerings are becoming central to how GitLab monetizes. The systems that meter, rate, and bill that consumption sit underneath all of it. You'll own the backend usage billing pipeline and its product direction while supporting the Monetization Platform and Infrastructure team as it modernizes the foundations underneath it.</p> <p>When another GitLab team launches a credit-consuming capability, you'll help them make it billable across GitLab.com, self-managed, and GitLab Dedicated. This is a technical, systems-oriented product role: success means building a monetization platform other teams can launch on quickly and correctly, rather than shipping customer-facing UI.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own the product direction for metering, aggregation, and rating in GitLab's usage billing pipeline, including the Zuora and CustomersDot integrations that turn usage into invoiced revenue.</li> <li>Make onboarding a new credit-consuming capability a repeatable process rather than a bespoke project each time.</li> <li>Partner with product teams on what to instrument, how to meter and price usage across GitLab.com, self-managed, and GitLab Dedicated, and what it takes to be billable on launch day. Stay ahead of their roadmaps so billing doesn't delay launches.</li> <li>Prioritize pipeline scalability, performance, and reliability as consumption grows, balancing those investments against new capability enablement.</li> <li>Own billing defect detection and remediation so errors surface before they reach a customer's invoice and billing outcomes remain auditable.</li> <li>Support the Monetization Platform and Infrastructure team by framing problems, explaining the value of platform investments, and prioritizing them against operational risk.</li> <li>Define and track measures of billing accuracy, pipeline reliability, cost to serve per capability, and time to monetize so teams can make informed pricing decisions.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience owning the product direction of consumption- or usage-based billing systems.</li> <li>Experience with Zuora or a comparable billing and revenue platform, and an understanding of how product and finance systems interact.</li> <li>Experience with prepaid, commitment, or credit-drawdown pricing models (balances, reservations, overage, expiration) and the edge cases they create in billing and revenue.</li> <li>Experience launching new products or pricing models while coordinating across engineering, Finance, Legal, Compliance and go-to-market teams.</li> <li>Ability to bring together teams you don't manage around work their launches depend on.</li> <li>Experience defining problems for platform or backend teams whose users are often other teams.</li> <li>Clear written communication in an all-remote, asynchronous environment; you'll use issues, epics, and direction pages to lead.</li> <li>Familiarity with developer tooling, financial audit or revenue recognition, or an engineering background can help, but isn't required.</li> <li>You use AI tools as part of how you work: prototyping, analysis, spec writing, and investigation.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>In Monetization, we coordinate across engineering, Finance, Legal, Compliance and go-to-market on new products and pricing models. Our remote, asynchronous work uses written issues, and epics to keep decisions visible.</p> <div class="c-message_actions__container c-message__actions"> </div> <div><span style="font-size: xx-small;"><span style="color: white;">Remote-Global</span></span></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a> and <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. If you have a disability or special need that requires <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation" target="_blank">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process" target="_blank">recruiting process</a>.</p></div>

title: Supply Chain Manager (all genders)
description: Position: Vollzeit (40h) Ort: Remote (Deutschland) oder Berlin Start Datum: Ab sofort oder nach Absprache Sprachen: Deutsch (fließend) & Englisch (sehr gut) Du hast den Anspruch, dass jede Bestellung stimmt, die deinen Tisch verlässt, und führst Lieferanten in Asien so eng, dass Ware pünktlich und in der richtigen Qualität ankommt? Dann bist du bei uns richtig. Als Supply Chain Manager (all genders) verantwortest du bei Maniko die operative Beschaffung von der Bestellempfehlung bis zum Wareneingang. Von deiner Arbeit hängt ab, ob unsere Produkte in den Regalen der größten Drogerieketten verfügbar sind. Das sind wir! Maniko ist ein innovatives, schnell wachsendes Unternehmen in der Nagelkosmetik-Branche, das hochwertige Produkte für anspruchsvolle Kundinnen europaweit anbietet. Wir sind bekannt für unsere selbstklebende UV Gel Nail Strips-Technologie, die professionelle Ergebnisse bequem von zu Hause aus ermöglicht – und haben mit unseren Soft Gel Press-On Nails eine zweite starke Produktlinie im Markt. Unsere Produkte stehen national bei dm, dm Österreich, Rossmann und budni im Regal, und unser Handelsgeschäft wächst weiter. Aus dem Startup ist ein Unternehmen geworden, das im Regal mit den großen Beauty-Marken konkurriert. Groß genug, dass deine Arbeit in tausenden Filialen sichtbar wird, und beweglich genug, dass du Strukturen noch selbst baust, statt sie zu verwalten. Unser Geheimnis? Ein leidenschaftliches Team, das sich nicht mit dem Status quo zufrieden gibt und ständig danach strebt, besser zu werden. Wir glauben an Werte, die wirklich gelebt werden – keine leeren Phrasen. Bei uns heißt es: Facts over Ego: Daten und Ergebnisse stehen über allem – bei uns zählt das Beste für das Team und das Unternehmen, nicht das persönliche Ego. Challenge accepted: Wir sehen in jeder Herausforderung eine Chance, an der wir wachsen können. Power to the people: Vertrauen und Verantwortung gehen bei uns Hand in Hand – dein Impact zählt! Who if not you? : Wenn nicht du die Ärmel hochkrempelst und Dinge anpackst – wer dann? Deine Rolle bei uns: Du bist Owner unserer operativen Beschaffung und berichtest direkt an unseren COO. Aus der monatlichen Absatz- und Bestandsplanung machst du Bestellungen, die pünktlich, vollständig und in vereinbarter Qualität ankommen, und führst dafür unsere Hersteller in Asien und Europa. Dein Erfolg ist messbar: an der Liefertreue unserer Lieferanten und an der Fehlerquote in den Bestellungen. Deine Aufgaben sind : Du verantwortest den Bestellprozess für Fertigware, Komponenten, Verpackung und POS-Material, von der Bestellempfehlung über die Freigabe bis zum Wareneingang. Du führst unsere Hersteller in Asien und Europa durch Auftragsbestätigung, Produktion, Qualitätsprüfung vor Verschiffung und Versanddokumente. Bei Verzug eskalierst du früh und bringst eine Lösung mit. Du misst Lieferantenleistung über eine Scorecard (Termintreue, Qualität, Reaktionszeit) und machst Abweichungen sichtbar, bevor sie zum Problem werden. Du hältst Stücklisten, Spezifikationen und Artikeldaten so sauber, dass sich Planung, Logistik und Handel darauf verlassen können. Du steuerst mit Finance Anzahlungen und Fälligkeiten und stellst sicher, dass Zertifikate und Konformitätsnachweise unserer Lieferanten vollständig vorliegen. Du entwickelst den Prozess weiter: Standards für neue Lieferanten und Komponenten, Kontrollen, Automatisierung. Wo ein Tool oder KI dir Arbeit abnimmt, setzt du es ein. Was du mitbringst: Du hast mehrere Jahre operative Beschaffung mit Herstellern in Asien eigenverantwortlich gesteuert, idealerweise für eine Konsumgütermarke mit Handelsbelieferung. Du arbeitest genau, weil du ein System dafür hast, nicht weil du langsam bist. Du kannst zeigen, wie du Fehler abfängst, bevor eine Bestellung rausgeht. Du führst Lieferanten freundlich und hartnäckig, auch über Zeitzonen hinweg, und bleibst dran, bis ein Termin wirklich steht. Du wartest nicht auf Anweisung. Wenn etwas schiefläuft, sprichst du es früh an und bringst einen Vorschlag mit. Du bist sehr sicher in Excel/Sheets, sprichst fließend Deutsch und sehr gutes Englisch. Idealerweise bringst du außerdem mit: Erfahrung mit Komponenten aus der Beauty-/Kosmetik- oder FMCG-Branche (z. B. Verpackung, Applikatoren). ERP- bzw. Dispo-Erfahrung (PO-Workflows, Stammdaten). Erfahrung mit Pre-Shipment-Inspections bzw. QC-Dienstleistern. Was wir dir bieten: 🇪🇺 100 % Remote in Deutschland: Remote-first mit optionalem Büro in Berlin. Der Reiseanteil ist gering, gelegentliche Lieferantenbesuche gehören dazu. ⏱️ Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Somit kannst du privates und berufliches flexibel und entspannt vereinbaren. 🚉 Deutschlandticket: Für mehr Flexibilität und Mobilität. 🏃‍♀️Urban Sports Club Membership: Weil wir wissen, wie wichtig physische Gesundheit und Ausgleich ist. 🤝 Ownership: Durch viel Vertrauen & Gestaltungsspielraum hast du direkten Einfluss auf den Erfolg unseres Unternehmens und gestaltest maßgeblich unser Wachstum mit. 🌴 Workation: Deine Möglichkeit Urlaub und Arbeit zu verbinden. 📈 Wachstumschancen: Sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich. Bei uns kannst du dich weiterentwickeln und neue Wege gehen, unterstützt durch ein jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget. 🎉 Team-Events: Wir laden alle Mitarbeiter:innen regelmäßig nach Berlin ein, um eine gute Zeit zusammen zu haben und noch besser connecten zu können. 🖥️ Home-Office Ausstattung: Wir übernehmen deine komplette Ausstattung, damit du auch zu Hause direkt durchstarten kannst. ✈️ Individuelles Travelbudget: Für deine Besuche in Berlin, um gemeinsam mit dem Team aus dem Office zu arbeiten. 👥 Team: Ein schnelles, hochmotiviertes Team mit Office im Herzen von Berlin (Hackescher Markt). ✨ Eine Kultur, die inspiriert: Bei uns zählt jeder Einzelne. Flache Hierarchien, schnelle Entscheidungen und echte Teamarbeit stehen im Mittelpunkt. Challenge accepted? Dann bewirb dich jetzt und werde Teil eines Teams, das große Ziele verfolgt und dabei nie den Spaß verliert. Wir freuen uns auf dich! Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. title: Account Executive (m/w/d) – B2B SaaS / Enterprise
description: Introduction Als Account Executive bei Omnora übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle im operativen B2B SaaS Vertrieb mit Fokus auf Enterprise-Kunden und gehobenen Mittelstand. Du verantwortest deine eigene Pipeline, führst Deals strukturiert zum Abschluss und baust nachhaltige Kundenbeziehungen auf, immer mit dem Ziel, echten Business Impact bei unseren Kunden zu erzeugen. Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Senior Sales und Leadership Team zusammen, bekommst klares Sparring und hast die Perspektive, dich mittelfristig in eine Lead- oder Senior-Rolle weiterzuentwickeln, wenn du dazu bereit bist. About The Role And Potential Progression In dieser Rolle bist du vor allem operativ im Vertrieb aktiv : Du identifizierst relevante Accounts, führst Discovery Calls, orchestrierst komplexe Sales-Zyklen und bringst Deals über die Ziellinie. Gleichzeitig lernst du unsere Sales-Frameworks, Prozesse und Playbooks in der Tiefe kennen, mit der klaren Perspektive: Ausbau zum Senior Account Executive (größere, komplexere Accounts, größere Ticketgrößen) Optionale Entwicklung zur Lead-Rolle (z. B. Coaching jüngerer Kolleg:innen, Ownership für bestimmte Teilsegmente oder Branchen) What's in it for you Was dich bei uns erwartet – für Macher:innen mit Anspruch: Leistungsorientierte Vergütung: Fixgehalt + transparenter, quartalsweiser Bonus, der echten Impact belohnt – nicht Aktivität um der Aktivität willen. Klares Spielfeld & starke Story: Ein marktreifes Produkt mit klarer Positionierung, realen Business Cases bei Enterprise-Kunden und einem Markt mit hohem Momentum (Wissen & KI im Unternehmen). Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung: Du arbeitest nah an den Entscheidern, bekommst schnelles Feedback und kannst deine Ideen unmittelbar einbringen. Kultur echter Exzellenz: Ambitionierte Kolleg:innen, hohe Standards und gleichzeitig ein Umfeld mit Vertrauen, Klarheit und Wertschätzung – ohne Politik und ohne Bullshit. Flexibles Arbeiten, klare Erwartungen: Remote-friendly mit Optionen für Onsite-Tage. Wichtig ist dein Beitrag zum Ergebnis, nicht die Optik. Stabiles & wachsendes Umfeld: Profitables Wachstum, langfristige Perspektive und ein Thema, das für Unternehmen geschäftskritisch ist: mitarbeitergeneriertes Wissen & Intelligence Management. How you can make an impact In dieser Rolle kannst du echten Unterschied machen, indem du: Eigene Pipeline verantwortest: Du identifizierst Zielkunden (Konzerne & gehobener Mittelstand), qualifizierst Leads und baust einen belastbaren Dealflow über verschiedene Kanäle auf. Discovery & Needs Analyse auf Enterprise-Level führst: Du verstehst Buying Center, Stakeholder-Dynamiken und die Business-Pain-Points rund um Wissen, Enablement und Produktivität. Komplexe SaaS-Deals strukturierst: Du steuerst den gesamten Sales-Cycle von Erstkontakt über Demo, Business Case, Proof of Value bis hin zu Verhandlungen und Abschluss. Mit klaren Frameworks arbeitest: Du nutzt und entwickelst strukturierte Sales-Frameworks (z. B. MEDDIC / SPICED / Challenger), dokumentierst sauber im CRM und machst Deals damit plan- und skalierbar. Eng mit Marketing & Product zusammenarbeitest: Du spielst systematisch Marktfeedback zurück, hilfst bei der Schärfung von ICP & Messaging und trägst dazu bei, unsere Go-to-Market-Strategie weiterzuentwickeln. Kundenbeziehungen aufbaust: Du bist für deine Accounts ein vertrauensvoller Sparringspartner, positionierst Omnora als strategische Lösung und denkst frühzeitig in Expansion und Upsell. Omnora nach außen repräsentierst: Du nimmst an ausgewählten Events, Messen oder digitalen Formaten teil und trägst unser Value Proposition in den Markt. Skills to be successful Was du idealerweise mitbringst: B2B SaaS Sales Erfahrung: Erfahrung im Vertrieb von B2B-Software/SaaS, idealerweise mit Enterprise-Fokus oder komplexeren Entscheidungsprozessen Du hast nachweislich Deals eigenständig von A–Z begleitet und erfolgreich abgeschlossen. Sales-Framework & Methodik: Du arbeitest bereits mit einem strukturierten Sales-Ansatz (z. B. MEDDIC, Challenger, o. Ä.) oder hast großes Interesse, dich darin systematisch zu entwickeln. Du bist daten- und KPI-orientiert und nutzt CRM & Sales-Tools nicht nur als Pflicht, sondern als Hebel zur Verbesserung. Starke Kommunikations- & Deal-Skills: Du kannst komplexe Themen einfach erklären, führst souverän durch Gespräche mit mehreren Stakeholdern und fühlst dich in C-Level- oder Bereichsleiter-Runden wohl. Du kannst Mehrwerte auf Business-Ebene (ROI, Effizienz, Risiko, Wettbewerbsfähigkeit) argumentieren – nicht nur Feature-Pitching. Ownership-Mindset: Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Pipeline, deine Deals und deine Ergebnisse. Du suchst Lösungen statt Ausreden und bringst aktiv Vorschläge ein, wie wir als Team besser werden können. Hohe Energie & Effizienz: Du arbeitest fokussiert, priorisierst klar und kannst auch in Phasen mit hoher Schlagzahl strukturiert bleiben. Kultur-Fit mit Omnora: Du fühlst dich angesprochen von Prinzipien wie Extreme Ownership, Solution Orientation und Exzellenz . Du willst lernen, Feedback geben und empfangen und findest klare Worte hilfreicher als diplomatischen Nebel. Sprachskills: Ausgezeichnete Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mind. verhandlungssicher) in Wort und Schrift. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Account Executive France
description: Are you prepared to fuel the growth of an exciting scale-up that's transforming the logistics industry? Do you thrive on building strategic relationships and close deals? If so, we might have the perfect opportunity for you! Logistics? Maybe not what you dreamed of as a kid. But building a fast-growing international SaaS scale-up that’s transforming how some of the world’s largest industrial companies operate? That’s a different story. Peripass is a tech company at heart. We build software that digitises and automates complex logistics environments for companies like Bridgestone, Alpro and Arcelor Mittal. These companies have hundreds of trucks (un)loading every month, and our SaaS platform helps them orchestrate that whole process. Peripass is a high-impact SaaS platform used in international enterprise environments. Want to be part of this adventure ? As an Account Executive France within the Sales Team: Launch new product offer : you are mainly responsible for selling remote our newest product in the French market. Pipeline Creation and Management : Independently build and manage a robust sales pipeline with full-cycle ownership, from lead generation to closing. This includes identifying prospects, qualifying leads, and developing opportunities. Active Prospecting and Market Expansion : Engage in targeted outreach to win new customers ("logos") across four different industries, leveraging a strategic and personalized approach. Pipeline Momentum and Sales Velocity : Proactively collaborate with internal stakeholders and customer champions to maintain momentum, reduce sales cycles, and improve win rates. This involves consistent follow-ups, addressing blockers, and aligning on goals. Engagement and Time Savings Case Development : Conduct virtual meetings with prospects in your designated market. Work closely with technical pre-sales teams to co-develop compelling business cases that align with the customer’s objectives and expectations. Deal Negotiation and Closing : Take commercial leadership in deal negotiation and closure, ensuring alignment with the prospect’s needs while achieving company revenue and margin goals. This includes handling objections and finalizing contracts. About every 6 weeks, you'll come and check up on how your colleagues are doing in the Ghent HQ . To get you fully acquainted with your colleagues, you'll also get an in-depth onboarding at our HQ during your first 2 weeks Steven, our Sales Director has already been around the block in SaaS sales. You'll report directly to him and he's looking forward to coaching you extensively , so you can make your career at Peripass a real success story. What we offer: Win big in a booming market => Be part of a fast-scaling SaaS company revolutionizing yard management in logistics. Huge potential, untapped opportunities, and the chance to make a real impact in France. Uncapped earning potential => A competitive salary with a commission plan that truly rewards success. The more you close, the more you earn. Ownership & freedom => Take charge of your pipeline and strategy. We trust you to drive results, with the flexibility to work how and where you perform best. Backed by a winning team => From marketing to pre-sales and customer success, you’ll have a strong team behind you, helping you close and grow accounts. What you’ll bring: A solid experience in selling enterprise SaaS solutions . Ideally you have experience in the Logistics & Supply Chain sector. Excellent communication and negotiation skills. Strong stakeholder management to manage complex DMU's and land sales processes in international corporate environments. A partnership and win-win mindset while selling our solution. A great sense of initiative and perseverance , since you'll be opening up a new market. You speak and write French on a native level . You can have a professional conversation in English since that is our internal language. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Regional Sales Director, Financial Services
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As the Regional Director, Sales for our Financial Services vertical in the US, you'll lead a high-performing team of Strategic Account sales professionals to grow adoption of GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform across banking, insurance, capital markets, and fintech, helping financial institutions plan, build, secure, and ship software faster across the entire software development lifecycle. You'll be responsible for managing software sales, bookings, and revenue, while building strong relationships with new and existing customers who rely on GitLab to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, and reduce security and compliance risk. Reporting to the AVP, Financial Services, you'll hire and develop top talent, set clear territory and industry strategies, and ensure your team's sales plans align with GitLab's overall growth goals. In your first year, you'll focus on building a strong team culture, deepening our presence with leading financial institutions, and consistently meeting or exceeding performance objectives in a fast-paced, open source software and SaaS environment.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Lead, coach, and motivate a team of Strategic Account Leaders focused on the US Financial Services market to deliver software sales, bookings, and revenue results</li> <li>Drive territory and industry planning by analyzing market dynamics, customer needs, and competitive trends to identify and execute on growth opportunities</li> <li>Develop and own accurate sales forecasts, territory management plans, and growth strategies that align to GitLab's overall revenue goals</li> <li>Establish, track, and report on key performance metrics for the team, and take action to address gaps and improve outcomes</li> <li>Collaborate closely with Renewals, Marketing, Sales Operations, and other cross-functional partners to manage pipeline health, renewal performance, and deal execution</li> <li>Recruit, hire, and onboard top sales talent while investing time weekly to build and maintain a strong pipeline of potential future hires</li> <li>Create a high-performing, inclusive, and positive team culture through regular coaching, clear expectations, and ongoing development</li> <li>Educate and enable your team on GitLab's product, pricing, AI-powered DevSecOps positioning, and key industry and regulatory factors relevant to financial services (such as SOX, PCI DSS, FFIEC, DORA, and third-party risk and model governance requirements)</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>7-10 years of progressive experience in field sales, sales operations, and sales management in an open source software, DevOps, or similar software-as-a-service environment</li> <li>Demonstrated success leading and developing account-focused sales teams, including hiring, coaching, and performance management</li> <li>Experience selling to Fortune 500 and enterprise financial institutions, with a willingness to "roll up your sleeves" and participate directly in selling activities</li> <li>Proven track record of meeting or exceeding performance objectives (revenue targets, pipeline targets, etc.)</li> <li>Experience building and executing go-to-market strategies for regulated industries, ideally Financial Services</li> <li>Ability to exercise effective judgment, sensitivity, and creativity as needs change, and to thrive in a fast-paced environment with a challenging workload</li> <li>Strong relationship-building, negotiation, and presentation skills, including executive-level written and verbal communication and the ability to mentor others</li> <li>Alignment with <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/values/">GitLab's values</a> and a genuine passion for open source, with openness to candidates who bring transferable leadership experience from adjacent software markets</li> <li>Ability to travel if needed and comply with the company's <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/finance/travel/">travel policy</a></li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>You'll join our AMER Enterprise Sales organization, leading the US Financial Services vertical as part of a broader, all-remote team that collaborates across time zones using GitLab's asynchronous workflows. This team is responsible for driving new and expansion revenue, partnering closely with Renewals, Marketing, and Sales Operations to serve financial services customers and grow adoption of GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform. You'll manage a group of Strategic Account Leaders, build a pipeline of future talent, and help shape our go-to-market strategy in a fast-evolving, highly regulated market.. For more on how this team works, see our<a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/sales/"> Sales Team Handbook</a>.</p> <div class="c-message_actions__container c-message__actions"> </div> <div><span style="font-size: xx-small;"><span style="color: white;">Remote-Global</span></span></div><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. title: Manager, Renewals
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h4><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h4> <p>Reports to: Director, Renewals<br><br>This is a first-line people-management role focused on the day-to-day execution and coaching of individual contributors — typically early-career to mid-level Renewals Managers and Associates — rather than long-range strategic decision-making. The Manager, Renewals implements functional plans into tactical processes, makes routine operational decisions for their team, and relies primarily on their own experience to guide direct reports' task execution and career growth. Their sphere of influence is largely limited to their direct reports and primary stakeholders, and they escalate cleanly to more senior leaders when decisions or progress are blocked.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong>  </p> <ul> <li>Manage the day-to-day work of a team of individual-contributor Renewals Managers/Associates, most of whom are at early-career to mid-level stages.</li> <li>Implement functional renewals plans and strategy into tactical, day-to-day processes for a book of business.</li> <li>Maintain accurate visibility into team renewals performance in the CRM/renewals system for forecasting and reporting.</li> <li>Deliver precise forecasting for their renewal segment alongside Field Sales Leadership and the Geo Director, incorporating projections for churn and growth opportunities.</li> <li>Partner with Sales, Customer Success, and Finance to keep renewals and expansion opportunities moving, escalating unusual or high-risk situations appropriately.</li> <li>Solve renewal and team problems of moderate complexity by following GitLab's processes and policies and selecting the relevant solution.</li> <li>Demonstrate and coach business acumen — pricing, contract terms, whitespace, and expansion motion — to team members.</li> <li>Make routine operational decisions covering the team's day-to-day renewals operations, typically of lower complexity and risk, and escalate cleanly to appropriate levels when decisions or progress are blocked.</li> <li>Provide prioritization guidance to team members, helping them balance what is urgent and important to deliver quality key results and protect revenue and retention.</li> <li>Maintain and reinforce a clear renewal strategy for the team, ensuring alignment with broader Division and Company-wide priorities.</li> <li>Establish goals and tasks, set performance expectations, drive accountability, monitor progress, and ensure timely, relevant information is cascaded to the team.</li> <li>Enable the capacity and efficiency of team members by removing blockers and streamlining day-to-day renewals workflows.</li> <li>Clearly communicate team objectives and how they reflect Division and Company-wide strategy and priorities.</li> <li>Proactively identify and fill talent gaps on the team; care personally for team members and provide candid, real-time feedback and coaching.</li> <li>Recognize and proactively address engagement and retention needs, and foster an environment of open feedback and dialogue within the team.</li> <li>Rely on your own experience to advise direct reports on career growth, with a focus on building task-level skills.</li> <li>Coach team members on skills and behaviors aligned with GitLab's Operating Principles and high-performance culture, and weigh how prospective hires will amplify GitLab's values.</li> <li>Regularly demonstrate, model, and coach GitLab's remote working best practices, including excellent remote presentation skills.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You’ll Bring </strong></p> <ul> <li>Prior experience as a renewals, customer success, or sales professional, with exposure to renewal motions.</li> <li>Experience managing or mentoring early-career to mid-level individual contributors, or clear readiness to step into first-line people management.</li> <li>Strong understanding of GitLab's (or a comparable SaaS company's) renewals processes, pricing, and contract fundamentals, with developing business acumen to coach others.</li> <li>Ability to translate functional plans and strategy into clear, tactical day-to-day team processes.</li> <li>Sound judgment on routine operational decisions, with the discipline to escalate cleanly when issues exceed the team's scope.</li> <li>Strong prioritization skills and the ability to help others balance urgent versus important work.</li> <li>Demonstrated people-leadership instincts: goal-setting, accountability, feedback, coaching, and fostering trust and engagement.</li> <li>Genuine care for team members' growth, paired with candid, real-time feedback delivered productively.</li> <li>Alignment with GitLab's Values and Operating Principles, and the ability to coach others toward a high-performance culture.</li> <li>Excellent written, verbal, and remote presentation communication skills, with a bias toward action.</li> <li>Comfort operating in a fully remote, asynchronous work environment.</li> <li>The ability to travel for events such as trainings, team offsites, customer meetings, etc.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>We are dedicated to driving customer retention and growth by managing the end-to-end renewal process for a large portfolio of customers. Our mission is to deliver a seamless, efficient, and positive renewal experience that supports long-term customer success. We leverage automation, data-driven insights, and close collaboration with Customer Success and Sales teams to proactively engage customers, identify risks and opportunities, and ensure timely renewals. We operate in a global, asynchronous environment, utilizing tools like Salesforce, Gainsight, and Gong to coordinate efforts and maintain high standards of customer satisfaction. Learn more about our approach and best practices in the<a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/customer-success/renewals-managers/home/"> Renewals Manager Handbook</a>.</p> <h4><strong>How GitLab will support you</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/" target="_blank">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/paid-time-off/" target="_blank">Flexible Paid Time Off</a> </li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/erg-guide/#:~:text=Definition%20of%20the%20TMRG%20%2D%20Team%20Member%20Resource%20Groups,-TMRGs%20are%20voluntary&text=The%20purpose%20for%20this%20type,developing%20the%20sense%20of%20belonging." target="_blank">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/" target="_blank">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/" target="_blank">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave" target="_blank">Parental leave</a> </li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/finance/expenses/#equipment" target="_blank">Home office</a> support</li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. code to GitLab’s product and adjacent systems.</li> <li>Develop bug fixes, features, integrations, tooling, and performance improvements when strategic customer outcomes require direct engineering with SA, CSA, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Product Marketing Management, CSM, Support, and executive stakeholders to make technical thought leadership a shared company capability.</li> </ul> product codebases with high standards for testing, maintainability, performance, and security.</li> <li>Strong Ruby on Rails or Go experience and the ability to contribute directly to GitLab’s product and adjacent systems.</li> <li>Experience with AI-assisted software development, agentic workflows, AI governance, model evaluation, context management, prompt and workflow design, or AI adoption in enterprise environments.</li> <li>Experience diagnosing complex system behavior across application code, data stores, infrastructure, observability, networking, APIs, and customer usage patterns.</li> title: Director, Strategic Finance

GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As Director, Strategic Finance at GitLab, you'll own a small number of complex, company-wide problems from defining the problem through execution and handoff. You'll turn long-range strategy into financial choices and build pricing, deal, and commercial frameworks that help Sales move faster with better economics.</p> <p>You'll join an intentionally small, senior team within Strategic Finance & BizOps. You'll work with significant autonomy, bring together the functions needed to solve each problem, and transfer ongoing ownership once a capable business-partner team is in place. </p> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Translate GitLab's long-range strategy into financial scenarios, capacity plans, and investment choices that inform the annual operating plan.</li> <li value="2">Own company-wide initiatives, such as sales and engineering capacity, hosting costs, or product pricing, from problem definition through decision, execution, and handoff to the long-term owner.</li> <li value="3">Build and evolve pricing, packaging, and discounting frameworks using unit economics and market context. Give Sales practical tools, including recommended deal structures, minimum acceptable economics, and clear escalation paths.</li> <li value="4">Partner with Deal Desk to model non-standard and enterprise deals. Advise on financial terms and trade-offs for large, multi-year, usage-based, and partner-led agreements.</li> <li value="5">Design dashboards, budget unlocks, and investment gates that replace one-off approvals with clear guardrails operators can act on independently.</li> <li value="6">Work across Finance, Sales, Product, Engineering, and Data to solve problems that span functions or don't yet have a natural long-term owner.</li> <li value="7">Build the analytical and modeling capability needed for executive decisions. Move beyond requested analysis to proactive, prioritized recommendations, and turn complex models into clear recommendations for the chief executive officer, chief financial officer, and senior leadership.</li> <li value="8">Use artificial intelligence and automation to reduce manual data preparation and expand the team's capacity for insight and execution.</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">10+ years of experience as an investor, banker, consultant, strategic finance leader, chief of staff, or operator in a complex technology or software business. You've owned ambiguous, cross-functional problems such as pricing, deal desk, capacity planning, or strategic planning.</li> <li value="2">The ability to build complex, flexible financial models from scratch, including capacity plans, unit economics, pricing scenarios, and deal economics, and translate the detail into executive-level recommendations.</li> <li value="3">Strategic financial judgment that connects operational choices to growth, gross margin, cash flow, profitability, return on invested capital, and opportunity cost rather than relying on simplistic productivity ratios.</li> <li value="4">A track record of influencing Product, go-to-market, or executive decisions through quantitative analysis, not just reporting on outcomes.</li> <li value="5">Experience shaping pricing, packaging, or deal-structure decisions using unit economics. Experience with consumption-based or hybrid pricing is particularly helpful.</li> <li value="6">Comfort working in a changing environment where data and processes are incomplete. You can build frameworks rather than only administer an established recurring process.</li> <li value="7">The ability to represent the team credibly in senior forums, hold a point of view, and challenge weak assumptions constructively.</li> <li value="8">Practical, hands-on use of artificial intelligence to automate workflows, prototype tools, and scale your output, along with expertise in Google Sheets and the ability to use GitLab. GitLab uses Google Sheets rather than Excel for modeling.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>Strategic Finance is GitLab's cross-functional problem-solving and incubation team. The team takes on the chief financial officer's and chief executive officer's hardest, most ambiguous problems when no natural owner yet has the capability to solve them. We build the financial and operating frameworks, bring together the relevant functions, and then transfer ongoing ownership to the right business-partner team. Our current portfolio spans company-wide resource allocation and long-range planning, sales and engineering capacity, product pricing, discounting and deal structure, and hosting cost strategy.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only.
